# PyO3 in newer sr25519 source releases no longer builds on Python 3.7.
# Version 0.2.2 publishes a CPython 3.7 manylinux x64 wheel.
py-sr25519-bindings==0.2.2

# Preserve the legacy Flask 1.1 API. These bounds match Flask 1.1.4 metadata.
Werkzeug<2
Jinja2<3
itsdangerous<2
click<8
# Jinja2 2.x uses soft_unicode; flake8 3.x uses EntryPoints.get().
MarkupSafe<2.1
importlib-metadata<5
# The old setuptools setup_requires resolver ignores Requires-Python.
setuptools-scm<6

# The pinned Substrate client uses the verified 0.10 decoder API.
scalecodec==0.10.88

# Version 1 renamed the native module imported by the pinned Substrate client.
py-ed25519-bindings==0.1.3
